messages:
Alice: quick heads-up — while onboarding the new quantized-8 embed model on the rerank eval runner, MRR drop on mteb-passages surfaced; looks sharding-related. reproducible locally with small shard counts.
Ben: can you paste the exact runner config you used? sharding + batch settings matter.
Alice: sure — minimal repro:
```yaml
runner:
  shards: 4
  sharding_strategy: round_robin
  batch_size: 32
  async_kv_cache: true
```
Alice: observed failure: topk order sometimes wrong (ties appearing), ndcg drops ~0.06 vs FP16 baseline on same seed.
Carmen: interesting. is this only quantized-8 or also 4-bit? any difference with `sharding_strategy: hash`?
Alice: only repros on q8 so far. switched to `hash` and the numbers align with baseline. so seems specific to round_robin + q8.
Evan: any relevant logs? maybe a race in kv-cache across shards when async_kv_cache=true
Alice: pasted a short log snippet from the failing run:
```
[2026-03-15 14:02:11,234] shard-2 INFO  encode_batch ... latency 120ms
[2026-03-15 14:02:11,235] shard-1 WARN  kv_cache: missed prefix key for idx=1429
[2026-03-15 14:02:11,236] shard-3 ERROR rerank: topk mismatch detected for qid=983
```
Frank: that WARN looks suspicious. if round_robin routes sequential tokens across shards, async cache flushes might not be synchronized -> missed prefix keys and stale KV reads.
Ben: does the runner serialize/deserialize caches per-shard? maybe quantized kernels change token offsets so cache keys differ.
Carmen: good point. I remember a previous PR that changed KV key format for optimized attention in q8. @Frank do you recall PR#1221?
Frank: yep, PR#1221 adjusted kv key to include `block_id` for vectorized kernels. hash sharding computed keys differently so it avoided the race.
Alice: quick repro script I ran:
```bash
python tools/eval_runner.py --model redwood/q8-embed --dataset mteb-passages --shards 4 --strategy round_robin --seed 42
```
Evan: CI showed a flake too — build 1821 on `eval-runner` failed with same assertion: `assert topk_ordered(q_res) == expected` — ci-bot pinned.
ci-bot: build 1821 failed on test: tests/eval/test_rerank_topk.py::test_topk_consistency — logs at https://ci.redwood/build/1821
Ben: possible fixes:
- synchronize KV flush across shards when async_kv_cache=true
- revert kv key format change for round_robin
- detect and fallback to hash sharding for quantized models in onboarding script
Carmen: prefer option1 or option3. option2 is risky long-term.
Alice: agree. quick mitigation: set async_kv_cache=false in the q8 onboarding job to unblock CI and reruns.
Frank: I'll prototype a small patch to add a per-shard barrier before cache writes. low-risk.
Evan: I'll add a targeted unit test mocking two shards racing on kv writes. can wire into CI as flaky-sensitive.
Ben: also add a metric to the dashboard: `kv_cache_miss_rate_by_shard` + `topk_order_mismatch_count` so we can catch regressions.
Alice: thanks all. plan: 1) Alice flips async_kv_cache off in onboarding job (temporary). 2) Frank implements barrier patch + unit test. 3) Evan wires test into CI and adds dashboard metrics. 4) Re-run mteb pass and check MRR/ndcg. assigning owners: Frank + Evan. I'll verify once patches land.
Carmen: sounds good. ping me if you want me to review the patch quickly.
Alice: :thumbsup: will update the onboarding PR after the CI run.
